title: Lucky Thirteen Blackcurrant Menthol Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Lucky Thirteen’s Blackcurrant Menthol is a sweet and bold blackcurrant flavour e-liquid with juicy, sharp currants blended with cool and refreshing menthol. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend fuses fantastic flavour and cloud production, while the high nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for newer ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
